source: Official LaLiga 2026/27 calendar; dates and kick-off times as compiled from the ESPN LaLiga feed (which follows official LaLiga announcements, including the 13 August 2026 Celta–Osasuna postponement)
kickoffNote: Kick-off times are CET/CEST (Spain). LaLiga confirms kick-off times round by round, roughly three weeks in advance: Jornadas 1–4 are confirmed; later rounds show 'TBC' until LaLiga publishes the times.
subjectToChange: Fixtures are subject to change (TV selections, European competitions, Copa del Rey). BRYME updates the list as official changes are announced.
footnotes: Jornada 1: Real Betis–Real Sociedad, Real Madrid–Real Sociedad, Barcelona–Athletic Club and Valencia–Real Betis were postponed from their original slots because players returned late from the 2026 World Cup; rescheduled to 21–27 August 2026.
Jornada 1: Celta Vigo–Osasuna was postponed on 13 August 2026 (pitch unfit at Abanca Balaídos) and rescheduled for Thursday 27 August 2026, 20:30 CEST.
Pairings for Jornadas 7–38 are a complete round-robin partition of the official calendar, cross-verified against Real Madrid's official 38-round schedule (all 17 checked rounds match).
